name: Business events
description: A business event is an event that is immediately actionable and typically triggers a specific handler or response. These events are discreet, meaning they report a point-in-time occurrence such as a package being shipped or an order being received. Business events are focused on the type of event and the fact that an event has occurred, rather than the data itself. Business events are intended to be used to enable extensibility in applications in Fabric by allowing other Fabric items to react to these events and perform actions based on them.
